## Où j'en suis
HubSpot owner + ARR sync for the admin accounts page: the webhook subscription call was refused (401), so the approach moved to polling; #405 was closed and #409 opened with auto-merge and squash. Polling (15 min, windowed paging past the 10k search cap, ARR > 0 only) is committed, but #409 is still open: the e2e check `test_admin_accounts.py::test_accounts_table_shows_owner` fails, so auto-merge did not fire.

- [en-cours] #409 open; e2e fails because the fixture's trial company is now skipped by the arr > 0 filter
- [prochaine-étape] fix the e2e fixture (give the third company ARR > 0 or expect 2 rows), get checks green, then Noa adds HUBSPOT_TOKEN to Secrets Manager for staging/prod
- [essai-raté] managing webhook subscriptions with the private app token: 401, not supported for private apps
- [décision] poll every 15 min instead of webhooks, close #405 (source: t04)
- [décision] sync only companies with arr > 0, skip trials entirely (source: t10)
- [décision] token to Secrets Manager via Noa, open the PR with auto-merge (source: t12)
